title: 第一卷 第13章 我七宝琉璃宗不介意让上三宗的格局洗洗牌第一卷 第14章 族长这这到底是怎么回事
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 话音落下，玉罗冕脸上那副大义凛然的长辈表情，硬生生卡住了。
另一边，正端着茶盏准备看好戏的风家族长，刚喝进嘴里的一口热茶，“噗”
的一声全喷在了前面的红木桌案上，剧烈地咳嗽起来。
谁也没想到，水冰儿居然连半点犹豫都没有，直接把这门他们认为荒唐至极的亲事给接了下来！
水族族长站在一旁，倒是长长地吐出一口浊气。
宁天瘫在椅子上，愣了半秒后，立刻坐直身子，忍不住啪啪鼓起掌来。
痛快！”
宁天冲着水冰儿竖起大拇指。
“我就喜欢水小姐这种痛快人。
这门亲事，你绝对不亏！”
宁天心里门清。
不愧是未来能带领天水学院横扫高级魂师大赛的大姐大，现在看来，这女人不仅天赋绝顶，脑子更是极其清醒。
坐在主位的宁风致，也出现了极为短暂的错愕。
拉扯大半天，就这？
人一出来，当面几句话就成了？
“哈哈哈！
好！
好！
宁风致连说三个好字，放声大笑，端起茶盏一饮而尽。
“水兄！”
宁风致大手一挥，指着门外堆积如山的玄铁马车。
“既然冰儿自己点了头，那咱们两家这门亲事，今天就算彻底定下了！”
“外面那十八车聘礼，水兄即刻派人清点入库。
其中那三块魂骨，直接交给冰儿，也算是我这个当公公的一点见面礼。”
水族长也是反应过来，连连拱手。
“多谢宁宗主厚爱！”
宁风致伸手敲了敲桌面，语气变得更为豪迈。
“至于婚期……我来之前就看过了。
三天后！
三天后便是黄道吉日！”
“这三天，水家也不用去准备什么嫁妆，人到了就行，所有的排场，我七宝琉璃宗全包了！”
“三天后清晨，我七宝琉璃宗的迎亲队伍，准时踏入元素谷！”
宁风致三言两语，直接把事情敲定。
content_en:
After the words fell, the righteous elder expression on Yu Luomian's face suddenly stuck.
On the other side, the head of the Feng family, who was holding a tea cup and preparing to watch the show, just took a sip of hot tea in his mouth and said, "Pfft"
The sound was all sprayed on the mahogany table in front of me, and I coughed violently.
No one expected that Shui Bing'er didn't even hesitate at all and directly accepted this marriage that they thought was extremely ridiculous!
The leader of the Shui Tribe stood aside and let out a long breath.
Ning Tian slumped on the chair. After being stunned for half a second, he immediately sat up straight and couldn't help but clapped his hands.
"Okay!
So happy! "
Ning Tian gave Shui Binger a thumbs up.
"I just like Ms. Shui, a cheerful person.
You will definitely not lose out on this marriage! "
Ning Tian felt clear in his heart.
She is worthy of being the eldest sister who can lead Tianshui Academy to sweep the senior soul master competition in the future. Now it seems that this woman is not only extremely talented, but also extremely clear-headed.
Ning Fengzhi, who was sitting in the main seat, was also briefly stunned.
After pulling for most of the day, that’s it?
As soon as the person comes out, just a few words in person?
"Hahaha!
OK!
OK!
OK! "
Ning Fengzhi said three good words in a row, laughed loudly, picked up the tea cup and drank it all in one gulp.
"Brother Shui!"
Ning Fengzhi waved his hand and pointed at the pile of dark iron carriages outside the door.
"Since Bing'er nodded her head, the marriage between our two families will be finalized today!"
"Brother Shui immediately sent someone to count and store the eighteen carts of betrothal gifts outside.
Those three soul bones were given directly to Bing'er, which can be regarded as a little gift for me as a father-in-law. "
Chief Shui also reacted and repeatedly handed over his hand.
"Thank you so much, Master Ning, for your love!"
Ning Fengzhi reached out and knocked on the table, and his tone became more heroic.
“As for the wedding date… I read it before I came here.
Three days later!
It will be an auspicious day in three days! "
"In these three days, the Shui family doesn't need to prepare any dowry. It's enough when the person arrives. I, the Qibao Glazed Sect, will take care of all the pomp and ceremony!"
"Three days later in the early morning, my Qibao Glazed Sect's wedding team will enter the Elemental Valley on time!"
Ning Fengzhi settled the matter directly in a few words.
